# Backup service

## Requirements

- Backups must be encrypted with a key held outside the backup system, per Security Standard 9.
- Restore tests must be run every quarter, under Continuity Policy 4.

## Stories

- As an operator, I want a restore test to run automatically every quarter so that we know backups work.
- As an operator, I want to restore a backup to a new server so that I can recover quickly.
- As an operator, I want my backups to be handled safely so that I feel secure about my data.
- As an operator, I want to schedule nightly backups so that nothing is lost.
